scope: Faithful bounded repair-claim audit and current-request/commit/instruction binding within a trusted local operator boundary
facts: Read live request and full supplied instruction after request creation.
Verified source HEAD and clean working tree match request commit.
Independently inspected bridge, runner, schema, scenario and focused test suites.
Independently reran bridge/runner suites: 13/13 PASS. Reviewed supplied fresh three-suite log: 19/19 PASS.
Negative requestId, requestDigest, sourceCommit and instructionHash tests reject mismatches; modified instruction and fixture-origin eligibility are tested.
Abort-listener cleanup and bounded response read address identified concrete review findings.
assumptions: Authorized local writers are trusted; source does not maliciously change after initial clean check.

findings.detail: Mailbox binds supplied content; it does not independently authenticate a model or establish operator honesty. Artifact booleans are assertions.
Instruction loading is outside execution timeout; abort cannot forcibly stop arbitrary external work or undo side effects.
No full 500-skill campaign or similarity analysis. Fixture test success is not skill execution.
Audit reports automatic approval rejection; reviewer did not independently repeat KROM request and makes no KROM verification claim.

verificationChecks: No material inconsistency between reviewed audit and inspected code/tests.
PASS applies only to stated bounded audit; receipt integrity alone is not proof of audit correctness.
openItems: Retain local-writer, loading-deadline, forced-cancellation and similarity limitations.
No merge, deployment or promotion approval follows from this review.
rollback: No reviewer source mutation; additive bridge commit can be reverted through ordinary review.
